GeneDef.label: shared thirst
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene possess a strong desire to propagate their bloodline and a strong familial bond with their kindred. Hemogen drain and general mood of a bloodline's members are dictated by the amount of members the family possesses. The larger a family, the smaller the drain. A respect for the hierarchy is intrisic to the carrier's instincts: while an elder striking a progeny is seen as discipline and siblings of the same tier quarreling are trivial matters; hurting a higher kindred will have an immense psychological burden, killing one will be traumatizing.
